narrative.overview: TimeArc Mobile feels like a compact album made from measured life. An optional user wallpaper extends through the whole app, while the solid-color default and readable frosted surfaces keep every tab calm. Home centers one translucent collectible card and tucks its neighbors underneath. The warm-brown card back reads like a time encyclopedia with one-tap sharing, while each monthly report uses an original code-drawn seasonal scene.
keyCharacteristics: Cool neutral canvas with one restrained lake-teal control accent.
One optional privacy-safe user wallpaper supports every tab; the default stays solid and image-free.
App color appears as content inside a card, never as global navigation chrome.
One primary story, a two-column time encyclopedia, and two evidence facts per memory card.
Motion explains flip, navigation, and share-preview state only.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Lake teal is the only global accent. Per-app colors are content data and stay inside app artwork, charts, and app identity marks.

rules.name: The Proof Contrast Rule
rules.body: Body copy must meet WCAG AA. Muted text is never reduced below readable contrast to appear elegant.

rules.name: The One Breath Rule
rules.body: A narrative card leads with one sentence that can be read in a breath. Evidence follows; it never competes at the same typographic size.

rules.name: The Honest Number Rule
rules.body: Use tabular figures for measured values. Conversions always include words such as 相当于 or 若换算 and never masquerade as recorded behavior.

rules.name: The Flat Until Needed Rule
rules.body: Repeated list rows and statistics remain flat. If every block casts a shadow, the hierarchy has failed.

dos: Do keep the four-tab information architecture and make each tab deliver distinct information.
Do keep the current card centered, tuck neighboring cards beneath it, and preserve readable scrims over a global wallpaper.
Do derive every personal sentence from real metrics or label it as a conversion.
Do show an anonymized preview before export or sharing.
Do support full light and dark themes, safe-area insets, large text, and reduced motion.
Do preserve app identity with runtime system icons, known repository assets, or a generic initial fallback.
donts: Don't build generic analytics dashboards from repeated bordered statistic cards.
Don't use dark cyber-glass surfaces with low contrast, decorative neon, or effects that compete with content.
Don't place technical implementation copy, package names, database details, or platform APIs on primary product surfaces.
Don't use productivity scoring, moral judgments, or language that frames leisure and communication as failure.
Don't use vague personality labels, fabricated precision, or metaphors presented as measured facts.
Don't write first use, play count, or open count when retained data only proves foreground record segments.
Don't directly imitate reference products or another product's proprietary visual identity.
Don't combine a decorative border with a wide soft shadow, use card radii above 18px, or nest cards inside cards.
Don't expose raw window titles, contacts, URLs, or other sensitive context in a share image.
